ENCOUNTER:
On June 4, 2023, at approximately 1410 hours, Border Patrol Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] conducted a vehicle stop on Interstate 75 near Monroe, Michigan, with the assistance of Michigan State Police. Two occupants, [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)], stated that they are citizens of Mexico and that they did not have any immigration documents allowing them to be in the United States legally. Both subjects were arrested and transported to the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] Border Patrol Station.

ENTRY:
[REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] stated that he entered the United States in 2016 by crossing the border illegally near Nogales, Arizona. [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] stated that he entered the United States in 2018 by walking across the border near Nogales, Arizona, and was not inspected.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
The subject was processed for a Notice to Appear and was served with a Warrant of Arrest. The subject was transferred to Immigration and Customs Enforcement custody pending removal proceedings.
